title: Favorite trumpeters, New Orleans players, Chicago and Henderson
summary: Mason names Louis, Red Allen, Lee Collins and others, recalls Tio, Charlie Creath, Bix and Trumbauer, and Henderson's band in Chicago in 1934.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene
